description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1966/08 of 10.05.2016 and others  - Cad. Map No. 521001 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land registration and property matters, specifically addressing land titles, plot numbers, and land registration procedures under the Land Registration Ordinance. It contains detailed references to specific land plots, survey numbers, and registration authorities without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
